newsitem.title: CANADA: Quebec Securities Commission to be self-financing.
newsitem.headline: Quebec Securities Commission to be self-financing.

text.p: Quebec Finance Minister Bernard Landry said on Monday that he will introduce legislation this spring allowing the Quebec Securities Commission to become self-financing.

The reform would allow the commission to set and collect fees from issuers, brokers, investors and labor investment funds. Its spending would be approved by the government and fees would be adjusted to that its revenues never exceed its expenditures.

For a three-year transition period, surplus fees from the commission currently disbursed to the public treasury will be reduced to zero. The commission is expected to budget C$2 million for expenses in 1997/98.
